g.text: Does PMM improve El Niño forecasts?

g.text: Leave-one-event-out sLIM • RO = Niño3.4 + WWV26 • RO + PMM adds PMM-SST
Equal weight per event; February–June starts; monthly verification, leads 1–9.
Shading: 5,000 paired event-bootstrap draws, pointwise 95% intervals. Moderate/weak groups have only 3 events.
1982–2024 data; traditional ONI classes. Current-vintage retrospective forecasts; no future observed forcing.
